sections_target.text: Work Steps to be Carried Out

rows: First: Measuring the relay operating current setting value
Remove the relay cover and withdraw the relay connection plug from the current transformer secondary terminals.
Clean the relay and the cell with an air blower.
Make a direct connection (jumper) between terminals (15, 16) on the test plug.
Insert the test plug in place of the relay connection plug to the current transformer secondary terminals.
Connect the current injection leads from the Severker 650 test set to terminals (5, 6) on the test plug.
Switch on the Severker 650 injection test set.
Raise the current gradually until you observe movement of the relay disc.
Record the current value at which the relay operates as the disc starts to move.
Reduce the current to zero, then switch off the Severker 650 injection test set.
Second: Measuring the relay operating time at different current values:
Connect the Stop leads from the Severker 650 injection test set to terminals (1, 2) on the test plug.
Switch on the Severker 650 injection test set.
Set the injection current to 3 times the setting value.
Switch off the Severker 650 injection test set.
Reset the time meter display on the Severker 650 injection test set.
Set the Severker 650 injection test set operating switch to the (ON Time) position.
Record the relay operating time corresponding to a current of 3 times the setting value (note that the Severker 650 injection test set switches off automatically after the relay operates).
Switch on the Severker 650 injection test set.
Set the injection current to 5 times the setting value.
Switch off the Severker 650 injection test set.
Reset the time meter display on the Severker 650 injection test set.
Set the Severker 650 injection test set operating switch to the (ON Time) position.
Record the relay operating time corresponding to a current of 5 times the setting value.
Third: Measuring the instantaneous current operating value:
Switch on the Severker 650 injection test set.
Raise the current until the instantaneous trip indication appears.
Record the instantaneous trip current value.
Reduce the current to zero, then switch off the Severker 650 injection test set.
Fourth: Measuring the HDO element current:
Connect the Stop leads from the Severker 650 injection test set to terminals (9, 10) on the test plug.
Raise the current until the Stop indication on the Severker 650 injection test set lights up.
Record the HDO current value (PU).
Reduce the current until the Stop indication on the Severker 650 injection test set goes out.
Record the HDO current value (D.O).
Reduce the current to zero, then switch off the Severker 650 injection test set.
Withdraw the test plug from the relay.
Reset all indications on the relay.
Refit the relay connection plug to the current transformer secondary terminals.
Refit the relay cover.
